Method of Attack: Mimicked an example from React Native’s official documentation to trick developers into downloading the malicious package. Exploited a subtle imprecision in package management instructions where 'yarn upgrade' checks the npm registry before local files.
Discoverer: A vigilant community member who submitted a pull request to the React Native documentation repository.
Attack Vector: Documentation as an entry point, leveraging official React Native documentation for Fabric Native Components.
Impacted Systems: React Native development environments using the Fabric Native Components guide.
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of the malicious package 'rtn-centered-text' in the npm registry.
